title: dead/ metrics read_dir error silently skipped — metric goes stale
description: drain_once wraps the dead/ read_dir in 'if let Ok(mut rd) = ...' — a read_dir failure silently skips the dead-letter count update without logging. The metric from the previous drain cycle is then reported as current, masking a filesystem problem. When the dead/ dir fills up (disk full, permission change), the operator sees a stale metric and no warning. Should log a warning on the Err branch, same as the main queue scan.
